# Workspace instructions

- Frontend stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, and Vitest.
- Preserve the contract-first integration rule: do not infer endpoints or response schemas. Refer to `docs/BACKEND_API_CONTRACT.md` when supplied.
- Never fake conversions, progress, job records, backend support, or privacy guarantees.
- Keep components accessible, responsive, keyboard operable, and covered by tests.
- Do not modify backend processing/security modules owned by Agent 1.
